admission_gate.block: otherwise; no V0.15B LM-quality benchmark may execute

aggregation: component-wise arithmetic mean over 552 ordered non-self token pairs in each 24-token window; missing predicates contribute 0

cleaner.normalization: Unicode NFKC + casefold + strip leading/trailing non-word characters, retaining letters/digits/underscore/hyphen internally
cleaner.whitespace: collapse Unicode whitespace runs to one ASCII space and strip

fresh_source.selection_rule: recursively enumerate .md blobs at the frozen commit; decode UTF-8 with replacement; discard documents empty after whitespace collapse; collapse exact raw-content duplicates to lexicographically first path; exclude raw-content SHA256 values in the frozen CIEL-Omega development exclusion set
fresh_source.source_universe_commitment: SHA256(canonical JSON path->raw-content-SHA256 map over post-dedupe/post-exclusion candidates, json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon)))
fresh_source.split_rule: rank remaining paths by SHA256(namespace|relative_path); holdout_count=min(7,max(3,floor(candidate_count/5))); lowest holdout_count paths are validation; all others training

implementation_requirements: commit full cleaner/carrier/runner source witnesses before any GREMLIN document carrier measurement
commit implementation freeze binding all source witnesses before measurement
no code, vocabulary, thresholds, source selection, or weights changes after implementation freeze

probe.training_window_rule: 64 unique rounded equally-spaced starts over concatenated training cleaned token stream
probe.validation_window_rule: 16 unique rounded equally-spaced starts over concatenated heldout cleaned token stream

syntax_layer.argument_eligibility: normalized length>=2; not syntax operator; not stopword; not punctuation-only/markdown-marker-only
syntax_layer.rule_provenance: SYNTAX_RULE; no candidate confidence score is assigned to syntax-only relations
syntax_layer.syntax_operator_argument: for each syntax operator token i, connect to the first eligible subsequent token j within distance 1..3; symmetric pair contribution weight 0.7
syntax_layer.syntax_scope: for negation/modal/condition token i, connect to each eligible subsequent token j until the first raw token ending in one of . ; : ! ? or distance 6, whichever comes first; symmetric pair contribution weight 0.35
